gwt.given: A DbParameterCollection has no parameters, and a mapped model type carries a collection property annotated [MapToSqlTableValuedParameter("@Children", "ChildTableType")] whose value is an empty List<T> (equivalently: null, ImmutableArray<T>.Empty, or default(ImmutableArray<T>)).
gwt.when: The caller invokes Mapper.CreateInputParameters for that model, which calls SqlParameterCollectionExtensions.AddSqlTableValuedParameter<TModel>(prms, "@Children", collection, logger), and then executes the command against SQL Server through Microsoft.Data.SqlClient.
gwt.then: The collection contains exactly one Input parameter named @Children with SqlDbType.Structured and TypeName ChildTableType whose Value is a null reference (not System.DBNull.Value and not an empty IEnumerable<SqlDataRecord>, both of which Microsoft.Data.SqlClient rejects client-side before any SQL runs); the command executes without a client-side exception, and the server-side table variable bound to @Children contains zero rows. The same rule holds for every AddSqlTableValuedParameter overload: column-list, keyed-model, ShardKey, and the raw SqlDataRecord overload, which normalizes only a null reference or a collection whose Count is observably zero and passes any other sequence through without enumerating it.

target.label: unit tests asserting null-reference Value for every empty/null case

evidenceLinks.note: 15/15 CollectionMapWriteTests pass at ce1ba27 (empty, null, default ImmutableArray, keyed-model, ShardKey, raw-overload empty and lazy pass-through all yield a null-reference Structured Value); full ArgentSea.Sql.Test 124/124.
